task_instance: Design the CI/CD deploy pipeline for a new Guidewire InsuranceSuite project: produce the full set of pipeline artifacts the skill's Output section mandates (three blocking PR gates, immutable SHA-named config-package build, continuous dev deploy with smoke gate, manual/nightly UAT regression gate, canary-to-prod with traffic split plus a low-risk bypass, a rollback runbook distinguishing code-revert from bound-state recovery, and a two-phase schema-change discipline doc) against a small sample Guidewire project skeleton.
evidence: This is an authoring/design skill whose stated deliverable is the pipeline configuration and runbooks, not a live carrier deploy. Created a sample Guidewire project under <work>/sample-project (a Gosu rating class gsrc/acme/rating/AutoRateRoutine.gs and its GUnit test gtest/.../AutoRateRoutineTest.gs). Authored all seven required artifacts: .github/workflows/validate.yml (gate1 ./gradlew compileGosu, gate2 ./gradlew test, gate3 ./gradlew check), package.yml (./gradlew packageConfig then publish configuration-<git-describe-SHA>.zip to a secret-held registry, immutable name by SHA), deploy.yml (reusable slot promotion + status poll to RUNNING), smoke.yml (verification-probe + synthetic-FNOL, pages github.actor on failure()), uat-regression.yml (workflow_dispatch + nightly cron, regress.sh personal-auto/bop/fnol-auto/renewal-pa), canary-prod.yml (risk=high -> prod-canary at 5% weight, 24h SLO watch, ramp to 100% and retire; risk=low -> single-step prod), gw-pipeline.yml (orchestrator: validate -> package[if main] -> deploy-dev[slot:dev] -> smoke-dev[env:dev]). Plus docs/ROLLBACK_RUNBOOK.md (the decision tree: check integration_audit for bound policies/claims; NO -> revert package only; YES -> revert AND recover bound state via rate-adjustment endorsements / finance correction / FNOL re-route) and docs/SCHEMA_CHANGE_DISCIPLINE.md (phase1 add column read-old-or-new write-both; 1-week soak; phase2 read-new drop-old). Verification: ran a Python check using the pre-installed PyYAML (no install) that safe_load-parsed all 7 workflows (all PARSE OK), confirmed validate.yml contains all three gradle gates, confirmed both docs exist, and asserted the rollback doc distinguishes code-revert from bound-state recovery (mentions 'revert the package', 'bound', and 'endorsement'); final output was ALL_GOOD. Live execution of the gradle tasks (compileGosu/test/check/packageConfig) and the GCC promotion/canary curls was out of scope and not possible here (no Guidewire Studio gradle project, no GCC tenant), but those are the pipeline's runtime targets, not the skill's deliverable, which is the pipeline definition + runbooks produced and verified above.
